title: Freeform pool (as actually trained)
rationale: This documents what is actually being done, not a designed plan. There is no fixed per-session assignment: exercises are picked from the pool depending on the day and on what is free. effective_from is approximate - training began around June 2025 and this has been the de facto pattern throughout.

effort.policy: MEASURED 27/09/2026, replacing the earlier self-report. Mean RIR 1.1 over 21 working sets; three of seven exercises taken to actual failure (RIR 0). Reps decline within exercises (chest press 15/13/10, row 15/15/12), so the previous '3x15 at the limit' self-report was not accurate - the inconsistency is resolved and this is what he actually does.

progression: Self-devised double progression: when all sets reach the top of the range in clean form, add the smallest available increment. Originally a fixed 15 reps, later relaxed to 10-15.

items.note: naturally trained at 10-12, not 15 - the only exercise in the pool where that is already true
